jobs.occupation: Systems Engineer - Systems Engineer - Embedded Image Processing & Computer Vision (m/f/d) (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description: Your TasksWe are searching for an experienced engineer with expertise in image processing and computer vision for space applications. The ideal candidate combines a strong background in algorithm development with hands-on experience deploying image processing solutions on resource-constrained embedded platforms such as FPGA- and SoC-based systems. The successful candidate is familiar with the complete processing chain, from sensor-level image conditioning and compression through object detection, tracking, perception and autonomous navigation, up to hardware-aware implementation for on-board space systems.We are searching for an engineer who is experienced in one or more of the following areas:- Low level image processing (image enhancement, filtering, calibration, compression, restoration)- Computer vision and image understanding- Object detection, classification and tracking- Visual navigation, localization and perception- AI-based image processing for edge and embedded systems- Earth observation or spaceborne image processing- FPGA and SoC implementation of image processing algorithmsYour Responsibilities- Research, design and evaluate image processing and computer vision algorithms for on-board space applications- Develop reference implementations for image processing pipelines in Python and/or C++- Translate image processing algorithms into hardware-aware implementations suitable for deployment on FPGA and SoC architectures- Develop bit-accurate reference models and support HW/SW co-design activities- Optimize algorithms with respect to memory footprint, computational complexity, latency and power consumption- Support implementation, verification and performance assessment of FPGA-based image processing solutions- Evaluate and benchmark processing architectures and deployment concepts for future space missions- Define system requirements, interfaces and verification concepts- Coordinate technical activities with industrial and academic partners- Support proposal preparation and customer-facing technical discussions- Cooperate closely with embedded software and FPGA development teamsYour Qualifications- University degree or PhD in Computer Vision, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, Aerospace Engineering, Physics or a comparable discipline- Strong background in image processing and computer vision- Knowledge of low-level image processing techniques such as filtering, calibration and compression- Experience with high-level image processing methods including object detection, tracking, scene understanding, perception or autonomous navigation- Experience in developing algorithms for embedded platforms- Understanding of FPGA- and/or SoC-based processing architectures (e.g. Xilinx Zynq, AMD Versal, Microchip PolarFire, NanoXplore)- Experience with hardware-aware algorithm optimization and fixed-point arithmetic- Familiarity with model-based design, bit-accurate implementations and HW/SW partitioning- Programming experience in Python and C++- Experience with VHDL, Verilog or HLS is considered an asset- Previous experience in space, Earth observation, robotics, automotive ADAS or autonomous systems is highly desirable- Fluent in English, both written and spoken

jobs.occupation: Mechanisms, Mechatronics and Robotics Engineer (m/f/d) (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description: Your TasksInternal Development of Mechanisms and Robotics Systems- Define and analyze technical requirements and develop concepts for space mechanisms, mechatronic systems and robotic applications.- Support the complete development lifecycle from concept definition through verification and delivery, considering performance, manufacturability, reliability, cost and schedule constraints.- Coordinate technical activities with multidisciplinary engineering teams, including Mechanical, Structural, Thermal, Electrical and Optical Engineering.- Perform requirement flow-down, interface management and technical budget management at subsystem and equipment level.- Take technical ownership of assigned mechanism or robotic equipment and support its development throughout the project lifecycle.- Select, specify and size mechanism and drivetrain components such as motors, sensors, bearings, gear stages and transmission elements.- Evaluate mechanical designs, engineering drawings, manufacturing concepts and tolerance allocations with respect to functionality, manufacturability and reliability.- Perform technical analyses, trade-offs and simulations to support engineering decisions regarding performance, manufacturability, reliability, verification and cost, using tools such as MATLAB/Simulink and MSC ADAMS.- Support Assembly, Integration and Test (AIT) activities through active participation in integration and test campaigns, troubleshooting support and assessment of verification results.- Support the development and evaluation of future robotic technologies and applications for space missions.Contribute to technical proposals, internal R&D activities and the continuous improvement of departmental methods, processes and technologies.Technical Supply Management (TSM) of External Developments- Act as Technical Supply Manager (TSM) for externally developed mechanism, mechatronic and robotic subsystems.Serve as a technical interface between suppliers, project teams and engineering disciplines throughout the project lifecycle.- Define technical requirements, interfaces, technical budgets and acceptance criteria for subcontracted developments, support their proper flow-down to supplier level and contribute to the closure of related technical issues.- Review and assess supplier-proposed concepts, analyses, designs, manufacturing documentation and verification evidence to ensure compliance with project requirements.- Monitor technical progress, requirement compliance, risks, non-conformances and mitigation activities throughout the supplier development lifecycle.- Support the preparation, execution and close-out of technical reviews and milestones, including SRR, PDR, CDR, QR and TRR activities.- Coordinate and support verification, qualification, acceptance and integration activities, including participation in major subsystem test campaigns when required.- Support the successful delivery of compliant, verified and fully documented subsystems in accordance with project requirements.- Provide concise technical reporting and recommendations to project management and internal stakeholders.Your Qualifications- Successfully completed degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Robotics, Mechatronics or a comparable technical discipline.- 0-5 years of relevant professional experience in the development of mechanical, mechatronic, robotic or aerospace systems, including internships, research projects or student activities.- Good understanding of mechanism, mechatronic and/or robotics engineering principles.- Experience or strong interest in robotics, motion control, kinematics, autonomous systems or robotic mechanisms is highly desirable- Strong understanding of mechanical design principles, manufacturing processes, engineering drawings, geometrical dimensioning and tolerancing, tolerance allocation and technical budget management, with the ability to evaluate designs regarding functionality, manufacturability, reliability and performance.- Knowledge of mechanism and drivetrain components such as electric motors, sensors, encoders, bearings, gear stages, shafts and transmission systems, including their selection, sizing and performance assessment.Knowledge of tribology, lubrication concepts and mechanical performance assessment is considered an asset.- Understanding of systems engineering principles, including requirements management, interface management, verification and qualification.- Experience with engineering analysis and simulation tools, preferably MATLAB/Simulink and/or MSC ADAMS.- Interest in hands-on engineering activities, including hardware integration, testing, troubleshooting and participation in Assembly, Integration and Test (AIT) campaigns.- Ability and willingness to take technical ownership of assigned equipment and subsystems throughout the development lifecycle, including the progressive assumption of Technical Supply Management responsibilities for external suppliers.- Experience with CAD tools is beneficial for design assessment, communication with design teams and design reviews; however, the role is primarily focused on concept development, engineering analysis, technical coordination and system-level decision-making rather than detailed CAD design activities.- Strong analytical, communication and teamwork skills, together with a structured and solution-oriented working style.Fluent in English, both written and spoken; German language skills are considered an asset.

As a Medical Consultant you will support our customers in Poland. The positions require fluency in the respective local languages and include the opportunity to support additional customers in English (or German), as required.You will play a key role in supporting veterinary practitioners with diagnostic test selection, interpretation of laboratory results and case management, including treatment options.We welcome applications from Board‑Certified Internal Medicine Specialists (ECVIM or ACVIM), as well as experienced veterinarians with a strong clinical focus and practical experience in Small Animal Internal Medicine. If you enjoy complex case discussions and would value the opportunity to share your expertise, this role offers a new and rewarding professional challenge.Would you enjoy working from home, providing expert telephone consultations to veterinary surgeons in practice? If so, we would love to hear from you — apply today and become part of our collaborative, international team.The TeamThe Medical Consulting Team at IDEXX is dedicated to enhancing veterinary care through high-quality diagnostic support. We place a strong emphasis on peer-to-peer education and building trusted relationships with colleagues in clinical practice. Our veterinary consultants work closely with our Customer Support colleagues as well as commercial and laboratory teams to ensure the delivery of accurate, practical and clinically relevant diagnostic solutions.In This Role- During regular working hours, you will consult with customers by phone on diagnostic test selection, interpretation of laboratory results (both reference laboratory and in-house testing), and the treatment and management of medical cases.- You will discuss IDEXX diagnostic offerings, including test availability, specimen requirements, clinical utility, and result interpretation.- You will maintain and further develop your medical knowledge through self‑directed learning, attendance at scientific meetings, participation in internal continuing education, and regular review of current literature.- You may be asked to prepare newsletter articles to be included in IDEXX newsletters; writing or reviewing laboratory diagnostic or service updates on new products or services; or preparing other marketing, sales or promotional material.- You may also be asked to participate in IDEXX educational and organizational meetings as required.What You Will Need to Succeed- A veterinary degree with the right to practice.- We welcome applications from experienced clinicians with extensive hands‑on experience in Small Animal Internal Medicine, ideally supported by additional qualifications or equivalent experience or Board-Certification by the European College of Veterinary Internal Medicine (ECVIM) or the American College of Veterinary Internal Medicine (ACVIM).- Fluency in Polish as well as English is ideal. Minimum would be English and or English and Czech / Slovakian. Additional language skills (German, Dutch) are an advantage in this international organization- A collaborative, service-oriented approach, with the ability to work independently is essential in our team.- Strong interpersonal, communication, and clinical reasoning skills will be beneficial in this position.- Feeling comfortable to leave your comfort zone from time to time, pragmatic thinking and a high degree of resilience. - Computer literacy and a reliable, high-speed internet connection (minimum 100 Mb/s download and 30 Mb/s upload). This is a virtual role and requires the ability to work at a computer for extended periods.- For this position you will work from a home office but might, from time to time, be required to travel.- Starting salary from PLN 140.000 per yearWhat We OfferWhen you join IDEXX, you will find yourself in a challenging but exciting environment where you are given the opportunity to be yourself, innovate, and grow. We have so much to offer!- You will join a successful team who is proud of the work they do and motivated by their unified purpose of helping others.- You will work with people who are inspiring, open, and the best in their operating space.- We believe in you – with a team of over 10,000 employees all over the globe, there are lots of opportunities for learning, personal growth, and career expansion.- You’ll be part of a double-digit growth company in a quickly growing market and we are leading the way forward with innovative products, services, and a strong focus on our customers.Our MissionWe’re proud of the work we do, because our work matters. Every role at IDEXX contributes to enhancing the health and well-being of pets, people, and livestock. With over 10,000 global team members, customers in over 175 countries, and a fast-growing industry - we’re always looking for motivated and inspiring people to join us.A significant portion of our growth is happening all across Europe and with growth comes opportunity! We offer competitive compensation, incentives, and benefits. Our company culture is built on our unified commitment to our mission and our offices are rich with a diversity of languages, cultures, and ways of working.Have we piqued your interest and are ready to learn more? Apply today so that we can connect with you.IDEXX values a diverse workforce and workplace and strongly encourages women, people of color, LGBT individuals, people with disabilities, members of ethnic minorities, foreign-born residents, and veterans to apply.IDEXX is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will not be discriminated against because of race, color, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, citizenship status, disability, ancestry, marital status, veteran status, medical condition, or any protected category prohibited by local, state, or federal laws.Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach Vereinbarung
